verdict.rationale: Jira can be driven headlessly through its APIs. The features page lists 'Rich APIs', and community users describe running REST queries against Jira data and writing API wrapper scripts to file bugs without the slow UI. Evidence is thin, though: there is no documented CLI, CI integration, or service-account guidance, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. Rovo-built automation rules run inside Jira itself, so they do not count as headless or CI use. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI runner integration, documented non-interactive auth for pipelines, a discoverable API spec, and hands-on CI usage reports.
